title: Report desktop game archive extraction progress and support safe cancellation
finding: DT-005 base archive extraction resource and destination safety
classification: progress and cancellation behavior implemented; DT-005 remains partially remediated pending packaged platform smoke

change.progress: Native extraction emits expanded-byte counts tagged with the install operation id; the desktop listens only for its active operation.
change.cancellation: Each install has an operation id and a native cancellation flag. The cancel command remains responsive because extraction runs on Tauri's blocking pool.
change.preservation: Cancellation checks run during streaming and before promotion. Staging cleanup removes the partial generation while leaving the previous install and downloaded archive in place.

commands.result: passed: 1; cancellation after a partial staging write preserved the previous generation and removed the staging directory
passed: 98 tests, including archive validation, limits, recovery and cancellation regressions
passed: TypeScript check and Vite production build
passed: 7 report files, 1,545 route rows, lifecycle outcomes, cleanup and secret/path scan

limits: No packaged installer smoke or real game install/launch was performed in this change.
No actual disk exhaustion or hostile archive was executed.
macOS and Linux package/runtime behavior remains unverified.
The cancellation regression exercises the native extraction boundary; no interactive packaged UI cancellation session was captured.
